settings.entry_probe: one original-noise forward before intervention; no history or RNG commit
settings.mode: current F/A/P strictly above threshold; I/C at or above threshold; five finite scores required
settings.target: minus one margin for active default-candidate components, zero for inactive components
settings.objective: sum of squared positive target violations across all five components
settings.abstain: mode selects candidate zero if the default has no active components or any score is missing
settings.selection: whole generated action chunk; first minimum wins ties; no action averaging or gate edits
settings.noise: common per-parent/repeat/query/candidate SHA256 streams across all non-native families
settings.physical: existing fixed 8-step lift plus 8-step retreat, or 16-step hold; last gripper sign
settings.stop: success or original total 520 environment steps; candidate search ends after five queries
settings.analysis: pre-intervention entry mode; two repeats reported separately and averaged, never best-of-two
